pr.title: Retry the Codex marketplace once when its clone fails
pr.head: afe39b6354cff82cd941583453dc70b553fec21d

summary: install.sh installs Projector's CLI and its plugins for Claude Code and Codex, and project upgrade runs it to upgrade an existing install. The installer stops at the first host command that fails.

Codex keeps a Git marketplace as a clone, and it gives that clone a 30-second time limit of its own. On a slow connection, codex plugin marketplace upgrade projector can fail with git clone marketplace source timed out after 30s, and the whole upgrade fails with it. Running the upgrade again usually works.

This pull request makes the installer try again by itself. The two Codex commands that clone a marketplace, marketplace add and marketplace upgrade, now go through a wrapper. When the command fails, the wrapper prints a retrying row, waits five seconds, and runs the command once more. If the second try fails too, the installer stops with Codex's exit status, as it did before after the first failure. A marketplace add whose source is a directory on this machine clones nothing, so it is not retried.

cards.html:

cards.title: Review so far
cards.html:
• The review of d876ba8 was clean. It made one suggestion that did not block: a local-directory marketplace add clones nothing, yet a failure there was still retried with a message about a Git clone.
  • afe39b6 acts on that suggestion, and its review was clean too. Neither review opened a finding thread.

groups.title: The installer retries a failed Codex marketplace command once
groups.kicker: Two new helpers in install.sh, used where a Codex marketplace command can clone
intro: run_codex runs a Codex command with the installer's Codex home directory. The new run_codex_with_retry runs it the same way, and on a failure runs it a second time after a five-second pause.

add_codex_marketplace chooses between the two for marketplace add. A source that is a directory on this machine is read in place, with no clone that could time out, so it runs once. Any other source gets the retry.

The installer runs under set -euo pipefail, so a failed command stops the script. The first try sits behind ||, which keeps its failure from stopping the script. The second try's status becomes the wrapper's return value, so a second failure stops the installer with Codex's own exit status.

files.note: Adds run_codex_with_retry and add_codex_marketplace. install_codex calls add_codex_marketplace from both add branches and the retry wrapper from the Git marketplace upgrade branch.

checks.text: A second failure stops the installer with Codex's status. The test whose fake Codex fails every time sees the installer exit 3, the fake's status, and run no plugin add. A manual run with a fake Codex that exits 1 ended with exit 1.
Only marketplace commands that can clone are retried. marketplace remove and both plugin add calls still use run_codex, and a test confirms a failed Claude Code marketplace update runs once.

A local directory is added once. plugin_source returns the checkout's own path when the checkout has no origin, and the test at tests/test_install.py line 545 fails that add once and sees exit 3 with no retrying row and no pause. That test fails against the installer at d876ba8.
This branch runs only when the source differs from the checkout, so the source is the origin remote. That is a URL unless origin names a directory on disk, which add_codex_marketplace then adds once.

groups.title: Fake hosts that fail once, and a fake sleep
groups.kicker: Six installer tests for the retry, on fakes that can fail only the first time
intro: The installer tests put fake claude and codex commands on PATH, and a test makes a fake fail a command by writing it to a state file. A command written to the new <host>-fails-once file fails only the first time. Both kinds of failure now exit 3, a status the installer never uses, so a test can tell Codex's status from the installer's.
A fake sleep logs the pause instead of taking it, so the tests run without waiting.

files.note: Four tests cover the Codex upgrade: it works on the first try, works on the second, or fails twice, and Claude Code is not retried. One adds a local-directory marketplace and confirms it is not retried. One more, in ReleaseInstallTests, retries a failed marketplace add from a piped install.

checks.text: Against install.sh from main, the tests at lines 513, 532 and 853 fail. At this head all 49 installer tests pass, and so does the full suite, 928 tests with 1 skipped.
The installer never exits 3 itself: every literal exit and return in install.sh uses 0, 1, 64 or 69.
ReleaseInstallTests reuses InstallTests.setUp, so this piped test gets the fake sleep too and never pauses.

groups.title: The plugin guide describes the retry
groups.kicker: One sentence in the paragraph on upgrades
intro: The paragraph on how the installer upgrades what it installed gains two sentences. They name the two retried commands, the five-second pause, the retrying row, and the exit status after a second failure. They also say that a local directory clones nothing, so its failure stops the installer at once.

files.note: The new sentences match run_codex_with_retry and add_codex_marketplace. The rest of the paragraph is rewrapped, not changed.
